SIGLLAMA-V2.name: Signature Llama v2

architecture.type: decoder-only transformer (chat-tuned on phone-book AI profiles)

SIGLLAMA-V2.weight_format: SGLL v1 binary, int8 per-row scales

training_data.detail: 7,200 steps on 28,737 persona-dialogue examples (~1.88M tokens) distilled from the phone book's 270 AI profiles; trained to validation loss 0.064 (~3.2 epochs); weights published 2026-10-03 — as documented in the site's Data & Methodology section. Training corpus file and checkpoints are not preserved in the repo.
training_data.corpus_hash_note: corpus file not in repo; no hash published
training_data.optimizer_note: not recorded in the repo; not invented here

evaluation.determinism: deterministic:true replays byte-identical output (tested with published weights)
evaluation.note: no formal benchmark suite has been run against v2; scores are not published

SIGLLAMA-V2.intended_use: On-device chat, explanations, and demos in the browser; a talking brain for Signature site AIs.
SIGLLAMA-V2.non_intended_use: Anything needing guaranteed factual accuracy, medical/legal/financial advice, or safety-critical decisions.
limitations: Small (~4M parameters): can invent facts; verify anything important.
96-token context: long conversations lose their oldest turns first.
HALLUCINATION_RISK = PRESENT; FACTUALITY_NOT_GUARANTEED = TRUE; VERIFY_IMPORTANT_INFORMATION = TRUE.
SIGLLAMA-V2.safety: Model output is plain text only and never executed. Tool libraries are shipped code, never model-generated.

SIGLLAMA-V1.name: Signature Llama v1

corpus.sanitization: URLs stripped, whitespace collapsed, lines kept only if 20-420 chars and >=60% letters/spaces, deduped, shuffled with seed 614

sources.what: Signature spec abstracts, autoread blocks, AI explainer text

evaluation.determinism: tested 2026-10-01: identical prompt twice -> byte-identical output

SIGLLAMA-V1.intended_use: On-device chat and demos in the browser.
limitations: v1 is small (~3M parameters), lively, and a little quirky — like a bright intern. It can invent facts; verify anything important.
Context window is 128 tokens: the prompt is left-truncated to fit, so long conversations lose their oldest turns first.
Character-level tokenizer: spelling is fine, but long words cost many tokens.
No tools run by default: the model only generates text. Tool libraries run only when you load them.
Sampling with temperature > 0 is intentionally non-deterministic unless you pass deterministic:true or seed.
Offline use after first load depends on the browser's HTTP cache and has not been lab-tested.
